payload.text: {"summary":"Researched Uniswap v3 LP mechanics for the lp-manager Aomi app and wrote apps/lp-manager/research.md. Protocol side: documented concentrated liquidity (tick math price=1.0001^tick, sqrtPriceX96 Q64.96, MIN/MAX tick ±887272), fee-tier↔tickSpacing table (100/1, 500/10, 3000/60, 10000/200), per-range amount math for deposit-ratio previews, and fee accounting (feeGrowthGlobal/Inside → tokensOwed; fees don't auto-compound; live uncollected fees read via static-call collect(max)). Verified mainnet addresses (Factory 0x1F98431c…, NonfungiblePositionManager 0xC36442b4…FE88, TickLens, QuoterV2, SwapRouter02) and exact NPM entry points (MintParams/mint, IncreaseLiquidityParams, DecreaseLiquidityParams — credits tokensOwed only, never transfers — CollectParams/collect, burn preconditions, multicall/refundETH/unwrapWETH9, ERC-721 enumeration) plus pool read surface (slot0, liquidity, ticks, positions(bytes32), observations), all cited to Uniswap docs/GitHub interfaces. Risks captured: amplified IL, out-of-range = one-sided + zero fees, mint MEV/slippage mins + deadline, manipulable slot0, fee-on-transfer incompatibility, token0<token1 ordering foot-guns, burn/collect lifecycle invariants, NPM-only approval hygiene. SDK mapping: geckoterminal covers discovery/trending/top pools/OHLCV/trades/spot prices (naive fee-APR = vol×fee/TVL, labeled estimate); defillama covers measured pool APY (yields /pools project=uniswap-v3), protocol/chain TVL, price history; dune covers position history, realized fees, tick-liquidity and in-range-volume SQL. Writes follow the across-app pattern: host::StageTx with data.encode → SimulateBatch → CommitTxs routed continuations (evm-core namespace). Gaps found: (G1) no data app provides live positions()/slot0/static-collect reads — must confirm host view_state/run_tx supports arbitrary eth_call (across code notes no EthCall target existed for allowance checks); (G2) tick-level liquidity distribution missing from GT/DL; (G3) range-specific yield not covered by pool-average APYs; (G4) defillama_get_yield_pool_history is referenced in a tool description but not registered in apps/defillama/src/lib.rs; (G5) GT address ↔ DefiLlama UUID pool-identity join needs heuristics. Proposed 10 concrete agent actions: find pools, estimate range yield, list positions, position health report, open/add/collect/reduce-exit/rebalance (guided v1), and monitoring, with preamble invariants enumerated.","artifacts":"apps/lp-manager/research.md","followUps":"Confirm whether the evm-core host namespace's view_state/run_tx can execute arbitrary eth_call reads (positions(tokenId), slot0, static collect) — this gates the whole read path (G1); if not, the lp-manager client needs its own RPC reads. Consider adding defillama_get_yield_pool_history to apps/defillama (it's referenced but unregistered) or plan a Dune query for APY history (G4). Decide v1 scope for rebalance: guided exit+reopen vs atomic swap-assisted via SwapRouter02. Multichain support (Base/Arbitrum) needs per-chain address resolution since Uniswap warns addresses differ across chains."}
